extraction_notes: N-channel polarity is retained; drain current, drain-source voltage, gate-source voltage, and threshold values are positive as shown for the N-channel source.

Output and transfer curves were digitized directly from p. 3 Figs. 1 and 2 at selected visible axis positions without interpolation between unobserved observations. Fig. 1 labels the high-current family as VGS = 5 through 2.5 V; the 2.5 V member is identified as the lowest-current member of that family. Fig. 2 provides Ta = 125 degC, 75 degC, and -55 degC curves.

Capacitance curves were digitized directly from p. 3 Fig. 5 at selected visible axis positions without interpolation. The figure specifies Ta = 25 degC through the page heading but does not specify VGS or test frequency; the tabulated capacitances separately specify VDS = 10 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz.

The static table publishes RDS(on) maximum values of 0.055 ohm at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 2.5 A and 0.072 ohm at VGS = 2.5 V, ID = 2.0 A; rdson_points represent the published typical values because the schema has no separate maximum-resistance field.
The static table publishes IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = 20 V, VGS = 0 V and IGSS maximum +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-8 V, VDS = 0 V; the schema has no dedicated leakage fields.

The switching table publishes Qg typical 4.5 nC, Qgs typical 0.8 nC, and Qgd typical 0.5 nC at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 10 V, ID = 2.5 A; it also publishes td(on) 3 ns, tr 29 ns, td(off) 6 ns, and tf 22 ns under the stated switching conditions. The schema has no dedicated switching-field slots.

The maximum ratings table publishes VDS = 20 V, VGS = +/-10 V, ID = 3 A, IDM = 8 A, PD = 700 mW, RthetaJA = 178 K/W, and TJ/TSTG = -55 to +150 degC. The schema has no dedicated maximum-rating or thermal-resistance fields.
